query: Russia annual GDP growth rate recent quarters 2025 and Q1 2026, what is the trajectory and latest official figures from Rosstat and Trading Economics
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of what I found on Russia's GDP growth trajectory:

## Key Findings

**The trajectory is a clear, steady deceleration turning into contraction:**

| Period | GDP growth (y/y) |
|---|---|
| Q4 2024 | +4.3% |
| Q1 2025 | +1.4% |
| Q2 2025 | +1.1% |
| Q3 2025 | +0.6% |
| Q4 2025 | ~+1.0% |
| **Q1 2026** | **−0.2%** (first contraction since Q1 2023) |

**Latest official figures:**
- **Q1 2026: −0.2% y/y** — confirmed by Rosstat, matching the preliminary estimate. First annual decline in three years, with manufacturing (−1.5%), professional/scientific/technical activities (−6.1%), and transport (−1.8%) all contracting.
- **Full-year 2025: +1.0%** (Rosstat), down sharply from 4.9% in 2024.
- **Latest monthly: May 2026 = +0.3% y/y**, down from +1.3% in April.

**Forecast context:** The Russian government slashed its 2026 forecast to just **0.4%** (from 1.3%); Sberbank cut to 0.5–1.0%.

**Data note:** The World Bank annual GDP API returned no data for Russia (404), so the figures rely on Rosstat, Trading Economics, Interfax, BOFIT, and Meduza/Moscow Times. Full structured findings with all data points and sources have been submitted.

key_facts: Russia GDP contracted 0.2% y/y in Q1 2026 — the first annual decline since Q1 2023 (Rosstat-confirmed, matching preliminary estimate).
Full-year 2025 GDP growth was 1.0% (Rosstat, confirmed Feb 2026), down sharply from 4.9% in 2024.
Quarterly y/y growth in 2025 slowed steadily: Q1 +1.4%, Q2 +1.1%, Q3 +0.6%, with Q4 near +1.0%.
Q1 2026 sector contractions: manufacturing −1.5%, professional/scientific/technical activities −6.1%, transportation & storage −1.8%.
Russian government (Deputy PM Novak) cut its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 0.4%, down from 1.3% projected in Sept 2025.
Monthly GDP y/y slowed to +0.3% in May 2026 from +1.3% in April 2026 (Ministry of Economic Development).
Sberbank cut its 2026 Russia GDP forecast to 0.5%-1.0% (from 1.0%-1.5%) after weak Q1 performance.
The slowdown reflects heavy military spending, low oil prices, weaker gas exports under sanctions, muted China trade, a strong ruble, and high policy rates.
2024 growth was revised up to 4.9% and 2023 to 4.1% in Rosstat revisions.
